CREATE TABLE course (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);
    CREATE TABLE enrollment (course_id INTEGER, grade DECIMAL, FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES course(id));
correct_query: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(e.grade), 2) FROM course c JOIN enrollment e ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING AVG(e.grade) > 85;
